elise: Heads-up 1: Our APAC office swapped the national observed holiday from Mon to Fri for that week; several ICs had booked floating holidays anchored to Mon. Manager asked if we can allow a one-off floating-holiday swap or let them carryover unused floats into the next FY. Any policy objections?

omar: Quick context: floats are treated differently by country (some countries call them "company holidays" vs "floating"). For APAC team members in SG and KR we typically allow 1-day swap with manager approval if it's within the same fiscal year.

chris: From People Ops POV we can allow a one-time swap (move the floating day to the new observed date) or convert unused floating days to carryover up to the policy cap. Need to know how many people + which countries.

min-hee: min-hee (Seoul): 4 folks in KR, 2 in SG. One KR engineer is on a restricted visa and needs to keep their days for a family event later; they'd prefer carryover.

payroll-bot: payroll-bot: Note: Carryover treatment impacts payroll and leave balances differently per jurisdiction. If carryover increases balance beyond 40h cap, exception required. Any cash payout triggers final-pay rules in some states.

elise: Good point. Manager prefers carryover for the visa case and swap for the others. Can we do mixed handling?

chris: Yes, mixed is okay if we document decisions and get manager sign-off per person. For KR staff we must also confirm local statutory holiday rules (won't double-count). I'll add a checklist.

people-ops-bot: people-ops-bot: Checklist template: required fields -> employee name, country, employee id, requested action (swap/carryover/payout), manager approval, reason, use-by date if carryover. Use /docs/hr/float-swap-checklist.md

min-hee: For KR colleagues, if we approve carryover, we should specify a use-by date (e.g., within 9 months) because carryover beyond that raises payroll provisioning issues.

payroll-bot: payroll-bot: Payroll needs: 1) csv with rows per employee, 2) effective balance date, 3) pay code (CARRY or SWAP), 4) if payout, GL account. Example CSV for swaps/carryovers: 

```
employee_id,country,action,hours,effective_date,pay_code,notes
33221,KR,carryover,8,2026-04-01,CARRY,visa exception approved
33222,KR,swap,8,2026-03-12,SWAP,move to observed holiday
```

omar: Legal check for KR: confirm no restriction on carrying company-designated floats to next FY for visa holders. I'll ping legal.

chris: Action items: elise to gather list by EOD; payroll to confirm CSV mapping and cutoff; legal (omar) to confirm statutory implications for KR; people-ops will issue written approval per employee and add to HR tracker.

elise: Will post the list here once compiled. Thanks all :pray:
